# Evaluation: antideepfake-w2v-small on In-the-Wild

*Generated by `eval/analyze.py`. Test speakers only, unless marked dev. Brackets are 95%
confidence intervals from resampling whole speakers. Scores are raw (uncalibrated) unless
marked calibrated.*

## Headline (clean audio, test speakers)

| Metric | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Clips scored | 23,098 (8,694 fake) from 43 speakers |
| EER | 3.2% (2.3% to 4.5%) |
| ROC-AUC | 0.995 (0.992 to 0.997) |
| Fakes caught at 1% false positives | 92.3% (88.2% to 95.4%) |
| Fakes caught at 5% false positives | 97.7% (95.7% to 98.8%) |
| Not assessed (too little sound) | genuine 16.0% (2,752), synthetic 11.3% (1,103) |

## Shortcut check: clip length

Clip duration alone, with no model: AUC 0.624, EER 41.1%. Correlation between score and duration among genuine clips (Spearman): -0.35.

| Duration | Clips | Fake share | EER | AUC |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0-2 s | 2,606 | 24.9% | 10.3% | 0.962 |
| 2-4 s | 10,359 | 31.2% | 3.8% | 0.993 |
| 4-8 s | 7,241 | 42.3% | 1.0% | 1.000 |
| 8 s and up | 2,892 | 60.5% | 3.3% | 0.998 |

## Calibration (fitted on dev, measured on test)

Platt scaling: a = 0.837, b = 0.424, fitted on dev data that is 42.1% fake.

|  | ECE | Brier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Raw | 0.018 | 0.025 |
| Calibrated | 0.012 | 0.023 |

## Bands (thresholds chosen on dev, applied to test)

*Likely synthetic* at raw score 0.653 or above (at most 1.0% of genuine dev clips). *Likely genuine* below 0.039 (at least 99.0% of dev fakes stay above it).

| Test clips | Likely synthetic | Uncertain | Likely genuine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Genuine | 1.0% | 4.4% | 94.6% |
| Synthetic | 92.7% | 5.1% | 2.2% |

At the *likely synthetic* threshold: test false-positive rate 1.0%, detection rate 92.7%. Share of alerts that would be real fakes at different base rates:

| Share of recordings that are fake | Share of alerts that are fakes |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1 | 90.8% |
| 0.01 | 47.3% |
| 0.001 | 8.2% |

## In-domain reference: ASVspoof 2019 LA eval (5,000-clip sample)

Lab-generated speech. AntiDeepfake was trained on ASVspoof 2019, so this is seen
data, a ceiling for comparison rather than a held-out result.

| EER | ROC-AUC | Fakes caught at 1% FPR | Clips |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4.9% (4.1% to 6.1%) | 0.988 (0.984 to 0.991) | 87.3% (82.1% to 92.5%) | 4,670 |
